4. Zombies swarm toward the locked basement door while Amy shoots and slashes them with her pistol and katana, decapitating and dismembering each one before they can break through.
5. A second zombie lunges; Amy dismembers it by slicing its torso with the blade.
6. Amy cuts through a swarm of zombies inside the basement, slicing heads off and dismembering bodies with her katana while the locked basement door stays shut.
# Phase 2

8. Amy unlocks the basement door and lets Will and Amber climb out into the living room.
